query:
WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
            SELECT id, parent_job, kind, runnable_id, runnable_path, 1 AS depth
            FROM v2_job WHERE id = $1 AND workspace_id = $2 AND tag = $3
          UNION ALL
            SELECT j.id, j.parent_job, j.kind, j.runnable_id, j.runnable_path, chain.depth + 1
            FROM v2_job j JOIN chain ON j.id = chain.parent_job
            WHERE j.workspace_id = $2 AND j.tag = $3 AND chain.depth < 64
        )
        SELECT id AS "id!", kind AS "kind!: JobKind", runnable_id AS "runnable_id: ScriptHash",
            (kind = 'flow' AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM flow
                WHERE flow.workspace_id = $2 AND flow.path = chain.runnable_path
                    AND COALESCE(flow.tag, '') <> ''
            )) AS "declares_tag!"
        FROM chain ORDER BY depth
